name: Canon Ultimion photon-counting CT
description: Canon developed a general-purpose CT scanner with a cadmium zinc telluride photon-counting detector for simultaneous high-resolution and spectral imaging.

date.basis: Canon dates the start of joint research using Ultimion to March 2026.

events.statement: Canon began joint clinical research using Ultimion with National Cancer Center Japan facilities in Chiba.
events.caveats: The manufacturer reports research activity. This statement does not establish routine clinical scans.

evidence.supports: Identifies the Ultimion model and the National Cancer Center Hospital East and related research centre.

date.basis: Canon announced the 17 April start of Japanese sales, and its later chronology says the April launch occurred.

events.statement: Canon made Ultimion commercially available in Japan.

evidence.supports: Gives 17 April as the Japanese launch and restricts sales to Japan.
Reports the April release in Japan as completed.

earliest_record.rationale: The manufacturer first attests to research with the commercial model in March. The 2023 operator announcement concerns a preceding research system.

unresolved.note: Named routine-care installations and the technical design changes from the earlier research platform remain open.
